spans.s: मह् (I) vi. 1Ā (pres. मंहते) To grow, to increase.
मह् (II) vt. 10U (pp. महित; pres. महयति-ते) To value greatly, to honour, to revere, to worship, e.g. गोप्तारं न निधीनां महयंति महेश्वरं विबुधाः.
माह् vt. 1U (pres. माहति-ते) To measure.
मह m. 1. A festival, न खलु दूरगतोप्यतिवर्तते महमसाविति बंधुतयोदितैः Sis.vi.19; 2. a buffalo; 3. light lustre; 4. a sacrifice.
महा (I) f. A cow.
महा (II) a. (A substitute for महत् at the beginning of Karm. and Bahu. compounds and also at the beginning of some other irregular compounds).
महक m. 1. A distinguished man; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 3. a tortoise.

महत् (I) a. (f. ती; compar. महीयस्; super. महिष्ठ) (nom. महान्-हान्तौ-हान्तः; acc. pl. महतः) 1. Large, great, extensive, ample, huge, e.g. महान्; 2. loud, e.g. महान् घोषः; 3. late, far advanced, e.g. महत्यपराह्णे; 4. long, e.g. महानध्वा, महती कथा; 5. intense, excessive, e.g. महती तृषा; 6. important, e.g. महान् कार्यभारः; 7. eminent, high, e.g. महत्कुलम्; 8. distinguished, e.g. महाञ् जनः; 9. dense, thick, e.g. महत्तमः; 10. numerous, abundant, e.g. महतो जनस्य मध्ये.
महत् (II) m. 1. The second of the twenty five principles of creation according to the Sāṅkhyas. See Sank.
; 2. a camel; 3. an epithet of Rudra.
महत् (III) n. 1. Kingdom, dominion; 2. sacred knowledge; 3. infinity, greatness.(महत् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘much, exceedingly.’)

महत् (I) a. (f. ती; compar. महीयस्; super. महिष्ठ) (nom. महान्-हान्तौ-हान्तः; acc. pl. महतः) 1. Large, great, extensive, ample, huge, e.g. महान्; 2. loud, e.g. महान् घोषः; 3. late, far advanced, e.g. महत्यपराह्णे; 4. long, e.g. महानध्वा, महती कथा; 5. intense, excessive, e.g. महती तृषा; 6. important, e.g. महान् कार्यभारः; 7. eminent, high, e.g. महत्कुलम्; 8. distinguished, e.g. महाञ् जनः; 9. dense, thick, e.g. महत्तमः; 10. numerous, abundant, e.g. महतो जनस्य मध्ये.
महती f. 1. A kind of lute; 2. the lute of Nārada, अवेक्षमाणं महतीं मुहुर्मुहुः Sis.i.10; 3. a kind of plant.
महत्-आवास m. a large house.
महत्-आशा f. high hope.
महा-दशा f. the influence of a predominant planet.
महत्-आश्रय m. protection of the great.
महत्-क्षेत्र a. occupying a large territory.
महत्-तत्व n. the second of the twenty-five principles of creation (in Sāṅkhya phil.).
महत्-तर (I) a. greater.
महत्-तर (II) m. 1. the headman of a village; 2. a courtier.
महत्-तरक m. a courtier.
महत्-त्व n. 1. largeness, great extent; 2. intensity, violence; 3. importance; 4. mightiness; 5. high position.
महत्-बिल, -विल n. the atmosphere.
महत्-बिल, -विल n. the atmosphere.
महत्-सेवा f. service of the great.
महत्-स्थान n. a high position.
महनीय a. (f. या) Worthy of honour, illustrious, glorious, समं महिष्या महनीयकीर्तेः R.ii.25, iii.69.
महनीय a. (f. या) Worthy of honour, illustrious, glorious, समं महिष्या महनीयकीर्तेः R.ii.25, iii.69.
महन्त m. The head of a monastery.
महर् ind. The fourth of the seven worlds rising one above the other from the earth.
महर्-लोक m. the same as महर् q.v.
महल्ल m. A eunuch in a king’s harem. (This is a word of Arabic origin.)
महल्ल m. A eunuch in a king’s harem. (This is a word of Arabic origin.)
महल्लक (I) a. (f. ल्लिका) Feeble.
महल्लक (I) a. (f. ल्लिका) Feeble.
महल्लक (II) m. 1. A eunuch in a king’s harem; 2. a large house.
महस् n. 1. A sacrifice; 2. a festival, an occasion of joy; 3. light, lustre, splendour, a ray of light, Nal.ii.5.
महस्-विन् a. splendid, luminous, brilliant.
महा-अक्ष m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-अंग m. 1. a camel; 2. a kind of rat; 3. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-अंजन m. name of a mountain.
महा-अत्यय m. a great calamity.
महा-अध्वनिक a. dead.
महा-अध्वर m. a great sacrifice.
महा-अनस (I) m.n. a kitchen.
महा-अनस (II) n. a heavy carriage.
महा-अनुभाव (I) a. 1. magnanimous, exalted, dignified, esteemed; 2. virtuous, just.
महा-अनुभाव (II) m. a worthy gentleman.
महा-अन्तक m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. death.
महा-अन्धकार m. thick darkness.
महा-अन्ध्र m. pl. name of a country and its people.
महा-अन्वय a. of noble birth.
महा-अभिजन m. noble birth.
महा-अभिषव m. the great extraction of Soma.
महा-अमात्य m. the prime minister of a prince.
महा-अंबुक m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-अंबुज n. a billion.
महा-अम्ल n. the fruit of the Indian tamarind.
महा-अरण्य n. a great forest.
महा-अर्घ (I) a. very costly, highly priced.
महा-अर्घ (II) m. a sort of quail.
महा-अर्घ्य a. valuable, precious.
महा-अर्चिस् a. having great flames.
महा-अर्णव m. 1. the great sea; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-अर्बुद n. one thousand millions.
महा-अर्ह (I) a. very valuable, K.S.v.12.
महा-अर्ह (II) n. white sandal-wood.
महा-अवरोह m. the Indian fig tree.
महा-अशनिध्वज m. a great banner consisting of the thunderbolt, R.iii.56.
महा-अश्मन् m. a ruby.
महा-अष्टमी f. the eighth day in the light half of Āśvina sacred to Durgā.
महा-असि m. a large sword.
महा-असुरी f. an epithet of Durgā.
महा-अह्न m. the afternoon.
महा-आकार a. great, extensive.
महा-आचार्य m. 1. a great teacher; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-आढ्य (I) a. very rich.
महा-आढ्य (II) m. the kadamba tree.
महा-आत्मन् (I) a. 1. noble, high-minded, magnanimous, द्विषंति मंदाश्चरितं महात्मनाम् K.S.v.75; 2. distinguished, eminent.
महा-आत्मन् (II) m. the supreme spirit.
महा-आत्मन्˚वत् a. noble, magnanimous.
महा-आनक m. a kind of large drum.
महा-आनंद, -नंद m. the bliss of final emancipation.
महा-आनंद, -नंद m. the bliss of final emancipation.
महा-नंदा f. 1. name of a river; 2. ardent spirits.
महा-आपगा f. a great river.
महा-आयुध m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-आरंभ a. enterprising, busy.
महा-आर्द्रक n. a kind of ginger.
महा-आलय m. 1. temple, a sanctuary; 2. world of Brahman (m.); 3. a place of pilgrimage; 4. the supreme spirit.
महा-आलया f. name of a deity.
महा-आशय (I) a. high-minded, magnanimous.
महा-आशय (II) m. 1. a liberal gentleman; 2. the ocean.
महा-आस्पद a. mighty, powerful.
महा-आहव m. a great fight.
महा-इच्छ a. 1. magnanimous, high-minded; 2. ambitious.
महा-इंद्र m. 1. an epithet of Indra, K.S.v.53, R.xiii.20; 2. a chief or leader in general.
माहेंद्र a. (f. द्री) Relating to Indra.
महा-इंद्र˚चाप m. a rainbow.
महा-इंद्र˚नगरी f. an epithet of Amarāvatī, the capital of Indra.
महा-इष्वास m. a great archer, a great warrior, Bg.i.4.
महा-ईश, -ईशान m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-ईश, -ईशान m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-ईशानी f. an epithet of Pārvatī.
महा-ईश्वर m. 1. a sovereign; 2. an epithet of Śiva; 3. of Viṣṇu.
माहेश्वर m. A worshipper of Śiva.
महा-ईश्वरी f. an epithet of Durgā.
महा-उक्ष m. a full-grown bull, a largo ox, रोधांसि धीरमवचस्करिरे महोक्षाः Sis.v.63, R.iii.32, iv.22, vi.72.
महा-उत्पल n. a large water-lily.
महा-उत्सव m. 1. a great festival; 2. the god of love.
महा-उत्साह a. persevering, energetic.
महा-उदधि m. 1. the great ocean, R.iii.17; 2. an epithet of Indra.
महा-उदधि˚ज m. a shell.
महा-उदय (I) a. very prosperous, very splendid.
महा-उदय (II) m. 1. great elevation, R.viii.16; 2. final beatitude; 3. the Kanyākubja country; 4. name of a city in that country; 5. a lord, a master; 6. sour milk mixed with honey.
महा-उदार a. very magnanimous.
महा-उद्यम a. See महोत्साह.
महा-उद्योग a. very laborious or industrious.
महा-उन्नत m. the palmyra tree.
महा-उन्नति f. great elevation (lit. and fig.).
महा-उपकार m. a great obligation, Bh.V.i.76.
महा-उपाध्याय m. a great preceptor.
महा-उरग m. a great serpent, R.xii.98.
महा-उरस्क (I) a. broad-chested.
महा-उरस्क (II) m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-उल्का f. 1. a great firebrand; 2. a great meteor.
महा-ऋद्धि f. great prosperity.
महा-ऋषभ m. a great bull.
महा-ऋषि m. a great sage; (at M.i.34 the term is applied to the ten Prajāpatis- but in literature the word is used to signify any great sage).
महा-ओष्ठ (forming महोष्ठ) (I) a. having large lips.
महा-ओष्ठ (II) m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-ओजस् (I) a. very powerful.
महा-ओजस् (II) m. a hero, a champion.
महा-ओजस n. the discus of Viṣṇu.
महा-ओषधि f. 1. a sovereign remedy, a drug; 2. Dūrvā grass.
महा-औषध n. 1. a sovereign remedy, a panecea; 2. ginger; 3. garlic; 4. a kind of poison.
महा-कच्छ m. 1. the sea; 2. a mountain; 3. an epithet of Varuṇa.
महा-कंद m. garlic.
महा-कपर्द m. a species of shell.
महा-कपित्थ m. 1. the Bilva tree; 2. red garlic.
महा-कंबु m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-कर्मन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-कला f. the night of the new moon.

महा-काल m. 1. Śiva in his character as the destroying deity; 2. Śiva established as Mahākāla in Ujjayinī; (this god is very famous in Sanskrit literature; Kālidāsa alludes to him at R.vi.34 and gives a beautiful description of Ujjayinī, the Sipra and the temple and temple service of this god at Megh.i.30, 32, 36); 3. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
महा-कवि m. 1. an epithet of Śukra; 2. a classical poet, e.g. कालिदास, भवभूति, बाण.
महा-कांता f. the earth.
महा-काय (I) a. bulky, gigantic.
महा-काय (II) m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. of Śiva; 3. of Nandi attending on Śiva; 4. an elephant.
महा-कार्तिकी f. the night of full moon in the month of Kārtīka.
महा-काल˚पुर n. the city of Ujjayinī.
महा-काली f. an epithet of Durgā in her terrific form.

महा-काव्य n. a great or classical poem; (according to the tradition of the Paṇḍits, these are five, viz., रघुवंश, कुमारसंभव, किरातार्जुनीय, शिशुपालवध and नैषधचरित; sometimes मेघदूत is added to these; but several other poems have an equal title to this name and the enumeration of the Paṇḍits has not much importance).
महा-कुमार m. an hereditary prince.
महा-कुल (I) a. of high family, well-born.
महा-कुल (II) n. a noble family.
माहाकुल a.(f. ली) Nobly born, of illustrious birth.
महा-कृच्छ्र n. a great penance.
महा-कोश m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-क्रतु m. a great sacrifice, a horse-sacrifiee, R.iii.46, 69.
महा-क्रम m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
महा-क्षत्रप m. a great satrap.
महा-क्षीर m. sugarcane.
महा-खर्व m.n. a particular high number.
महा-गणपति m. a form of the god Gaṇeśa, Yaj.i.294.
महा-गंध (I) m. a kind of cane.
महा-गंध (II) n. a kind of sandal-wood.
महा-गव m. Bos gavœus.
महा-गृष्टि f. a cow with a large hump.
महा-ग्रह m. an epithet of Rāhu.
महा-ग्रीव m. 1. a camel; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-ग्रीविन् m. a camel.
महा-घूर्णा f. spirituous liquor.
महा-घोष n. a market, a fair.
महा-चक्रवर्तिन् m. a universal monarch.
महा-चमू f. a large army.
महा-च्छाय m. the Indian fig tree.
महा-जट m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-जत्रु (I) a. having a great collar-bone.
महा-जत्रु (II) m. an epithet of Śiva.

महा-जन m. 1. the chief of a trade or guild; 2. a merchant, a tradesman; 3. a great man, a notability, e.g. महाजनस्य संपर्कः कस्य नोन्नतिकारकः । पद्मपत्रस्थितं तोयं धत्ते मुक्ताफलश्रियम्; 4. the mob, populace.
महा-जातीय a. 1. of an excellent kind; 2. rather large.
महा-ज्योतिस् m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-तपस् m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. a great ascetic.
महा-तल n. name of one of the seven lower worlds.
महा-तिक्त m. the nimba tree.
महा-तीक्ष्णा f. the marking-nut plant.
महा-तेजस् (I) a. 1. very vigorous, heroic; 2. of very great splendour.
महा-तेजस् (II) m. 1. a hero; 2. an epithet of Kārtikeya; 3. fire.
महा-तेजस् (III) n. quick-silver.
महा-दंत m. 1. an elephant with large tusks; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-दारु n. the Devadāru tree.
महा-देव m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-देवी f. an epithet of Durgā.
महा-द्रुम m. the religious fig tree.
महा-धन n. 1. gold; 2. incense; 3. costly apparel.
महा-धनुस् m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-धातु m. 1. gold; 2. an epithet of Meru; 3. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-नट m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-नद m. a great river.
महा-नाद (I) m. 1. a great drum; 2. a thunder-cloud; 3. a lion; 4. the ear; 5. an elephant; 6. a camel; 7. a shell; 8. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-नाद (II) n. a musical instrument.
महा-नदी f. name of a river which falls into the Bay of Bengal.
महा-नरक m. name of one of the twenty-one hells.
महा-नल m. a kind of reed.
महा-नवमी f. the ninth day of the first half of Āśvina, sacred to Durgā.
महा-नाटक n. name of a drama otherwise called Hanumannāṭaka; it is wrongly but popularly believed to be written by Hanūmat himself.
महा-निद्रा f. death.
महा-नियम m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
महा-निर्वाण n. total annihilation of individuality (in Buddhic works).
महा-निशा f. the dead of night, the second and third watches of the night (महानिशा तु विज्ञेया मध्यमं प्रहरद्वयम् Smṛti quoted by Sarvajnyanārāyaṇa on M.iv.129.
महा-नीच m. a washerman.
महा-नील m. a kind of sapphire, Sis.iv.44, R.xviii.42.
महा-नील˚उपल m. a sapphire.
महा-नृत्य m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-नेमि m. a crow.
महा-पक्ष m. 1. an epithet of Garuḍa; 2. a kind of duck.
महा-पक्षी f. an owl.
महा-पंचमूल f. the five great roots; (they are- बिल्वोग्निमंथः श्योनाकः काश्मर्यः पाटला तथा).
महा-पंचविष n. the five great poisons (they are- शृंगीच कालकूटश्च मुस्तको वत्सनाभकः । शंखकर्णी).
महा-पथ m. 1. a high road, a principal road, K.S.vii.3; 2. name of certain precipices from which people used to throw themselves to obtain entrance into heaven.
महा-पद्म (I) m. 1. a particular high number; 2. name of one of the nine treasures of Kubera; 3. an epithet of Nanda.
महा-पद्म (II) n. 1. a white lotus; 2. name of a city.
महा-पद्म˚पति m. an epithet of Nanda.
महा-पातक n. a great sin or crime; (they are five- ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वंगनागमः । महांति पातकान्याहुस्तत्संसर्गश्च पंचमः M.xi.54).
महा-पात्र m. a prime minister.
महा-पाप्मन् a. very wicked, very hurtful, Bg.iii.37.
महा-पुंस m. a great man.
महा-पुरुष m. 1. the supreme spirit; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 3. an eminent personage, a great man, महापुरुषसंरंभो यत्र गंभीरभीषणः Mv.i.
महा-पुष्प m. a kind of worm.
महा-पृष्ठ m. a camel.
महा-प्रपंच m. the great universe.
महा-प्रभ m. the light of a lamp.
महा-प्रभु m. 1. a great lord; 2. a king, a sovereign; 3. an epithet of Śiva; 4. of Viṣṇu; 5. of Indra.
महा-प्रलय m. the destruction of the whole creation at the end of the life of Brahman (m.) when all things including Brahman (m.) himself are annihilated.
महा-प्रस्थान n. departing this life.
महा-प्राण (I) m. 1. the aspirate utterance of the aspirated letters; 2. a raven.
महा-प्राण (II) m. pl. the aspirated letters (they are- ख्, घ्, छ्, झ्, ठ्, ढ्, थ्, ध्, फ्, भ्, श्, ष्, स् and ह्).
महा-प्लव m. a great flood.
महा-फला f. 1. a kind of spear; 2. a kind of gourd.
महा-बल (I) m. wind.
महा-बल (II) n. lead.
महा-बल˚ईश्वर m. name of a Linga of Śiva near Mahābaleśvara.
महा-बिल, -विल n. 1. the heart; 2. the atmosphere; 3. a water-jar; 4. a cave.
महा-बिल, -विल n. 1. the heart; 2. the atmosphere; 3. a water-jar; 4. a cave.
महा-बीज, -वीज m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-बीज, -वीज m. an epithet of Śiva.
महा-बीज्य, -वीज्य n. the perinæum.
महा-बीज्य, -वीज्य n. the perinæum.
महा-बोधि m. a Buddha.
महा-ब्रह्म, -ब्रह्मन् n. the supreme spirit.
महा-ब्रह्म, -ब्रह्मन् n. the supreme spirit.
महा-ब्राह्मण m. 1. a great Brāhmaṇa; 2. a contemptible Brahman.
महा-भाग a. 1. illustrious, highly distinguished, महाभाग सुश्लिष्टगुणतया रमणीय एष वः सुमनसां सन्निवेशः M.M.i., M.iii.192; 2. very fortunate; 3. highly virtuous.
महा-भागिन् a. exceedingly fortunate.
